headline: Silver Falls 1.38 Percent To $52.72 As Money Leaves The Precious-Metals Pipe
narrative: Silver fell 1.38 percent to $52.72, with money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Gold fell 0.39 percent to $4,035.8, money leaving the same pipe. Bitcoin changed hands near 80k and the S&P 500 rose 0.28 percent to 7,743.98, an equity bid apart from the metals sale.
author: jordan
